title.zh-TW: 註冊完成任務，賺 USDC 獎勵
title.en: Sign up, finish tasks, earn USDC

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；任務內容、獎勵金額與期限以 Binance 官方活動頁為準。
text.en: Taken from the platform's share text; tasks, reward amounts and deadlines follow Binance's official campaign page.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟活動連結，註冊或登入 Binance 帳號。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the campaign link, then register or log in to Binance.

steps.zh-TW: 確認推薦碼為 GRO_28502_SZ300；若沒有自動帶入，請手動貼上。
steps.en: Check that the referral code is GRO_28502_SZ300; if it is not pre-filled, paste it in.

steps.zh-TW: 依活動頁的說明完成任務，並依平台規定完成身分驗證。
steps.en: Complete the tasks described on the campaign page, and finish identity verification as the platform requires.

intro.zh-TW: 加入我，並獲得您的獎勵！註冊 Binance 並完成任務，一起賺取 USDC 獎勵。
intro.en: Join me and get your reward! Sign up for Binance and complete the tasks to earn USDC rewards together.

description.zh-TW:
這是 Binance 的「一起賺」USDC 推薦活動連結（邀請碼 GRO_28502_SZ300）。透過連結註冊並完成活動頁列出的任務，即可參加 USDC 獎勵。

本站另有一組 Binance 一般邀請碼（見「Binance」頁面）。通常一個帳號只能綁定一位推薦人，請擇一使用。實際任務、獎勵金額與期限以 Binance 官方活動頁為準。
description.en:
This is Binance's “earn together” USDC referral campaign link (referral code GRO_28502_SZ300). Sign up through the link and complete the tasks listed on the campaign page to take part in the USDC rewards.

This site also lists a regular Binance referral code (see the “Binance” page). An account can usually be linked to only one referrer, so pick one. The actual tasks, reward amounts and deadlines follow Binance's official campaign page.

notes.zh-TW: 加密資產價格波動大，投資前請自行評估風險。部分地區可能無法使用此平台或活動，請先確認所在地法規。連結帶有分享來源參數（utm_*），本站保持原樣不改寫。
notes.en: Crypto-asset prices are volatile, so assess the risks yourself. The platform or this campaign may be unavailable in some regions; check your local regulations first. The link carries share-source parameters (utm_*); this site keeps it unchanged.
